reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead 72b — card gallery simulation honesty and aria-pressed state)

spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the box-shadow edge clamping fix for high border-radius shapes (50% avatar circles, 9999px pill buttons and badges) with honest simulation labeling. However, secondary spec surfaces mentioned in ChromeStatus (near-circular, non-round contours, and corner-shape interactions) are not demonstrated on this card gallery page.

interactive.rationale: Live toggle controls switch between the simulated pre-145 spread and native Chrome 145+ rendering with aria-pressed programmatic state, updating live shadow styles across four UI components.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb and page H1/lede share the same framing and clearly identify the high border-radius shadow edge behavior.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers high border-radius geometry edge cases (50% circle on square, 9999px pill, 16px rounded card) and documents behavior when radius exceeds half the box dimension.

references.rationale: see-also section links to ChromeStatus entry and sibling calculation demos.

design_system.rationale: Button hover rules pair background and color together (.toggle-btn:hover:not(.active) sets both background and color). Token colors used throughout.

accessibility.rationale: Toggle buttons have aria-pressed attributes exposing programmatic state, 44px min-height tap targets on mobile, visible focus outlines, and shadow hint updates via aria-live polite region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified in Chrome DevTools MCP at mobile 360x740 DPR3 and desktop 1280x800 with 0px horizontal overflow.

openQuestions.title: Surface the missing API surfaces on card-gallery
openQuestions.detail: The chromestatus summary for Refine border-radius shadow edge computation for high border-radius introduces near-circular, non-round, corner-shape but the page does not mention or exercise them. Walk the spec and add a short labelled control or read-out for each, so the concept covers the headline API in full. Spec: https://drafts.csswg.org/css-backgrounds-3/#corner-shaping

summary: card-gallery updated (bead 72b): honestly labeled the before-Chrome-145 rendering as an interactive simulation, added programmatic aria-pressed states on toggle buttons, resolved button background-without-color hover regression, and verified 0px mobile overflow at 360px viewport. Retained open question and partial spec_match on non-round contour / corner-shape surfaces.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle buttons aria-pressed state and accessible 44px tap targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-pressed='true'/'false' on toggle buttons to communicate binary state to assistive technology, and ensure minimum 44px tap targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Added aria-pressed on toggle buttons and min-height: 44px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Chrome DevTools MCP evaluation confirmed aria-pressed toggles dynamically and minHeight is 44px.
